title: Empty Pillbox
subtitle: The cold metal tastes like toothless gums.

items.text: Bonfire Camping Area

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: This ... this must be the camp.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Huh, hah! I smell conspiracy in the air. What will happen here? Murder? Sacrifice? Spy attack? Or evocation?

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Let me see, let me see, let me see ... What do we have here?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: These things have been left here catching dust, and I see no footprints or any signs of activity. Seems like it has been deserted for a long time.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Iron buckets, felling axes, picnic mats. Considering we are in a campsite, it is only normal to expect these tools to be here. Hmm. What is this?
Sonetto crouches down, carefully checking a piece of metal that is half buried in mud.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Anything? Have you found anything, Sonetto?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Something is buried in the ground. Right here.
She breaks a twig from the bush. Without hesitation, she pushes the mud clods aside with the twig.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: A box made of iron or aluminum. It looks like ... like a candy box. Judging from the rust, it has been buried here for four to five years.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: A kid's candy box? No, adults can love candies too.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Looking at it from a different angle, is its owner still alive? What happened to the person here? Why was this box buried with a battered magazine?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: From the traces of activity here, it's probably been left by its indiscreet owner.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Wait. Is this the "Green Lake Campsite"?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We just met a madman who called himself an oracle. He drove people away from the land of demons.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Open it. If this is from a brutal crime, there might be some evidence inside.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: We are all ears, Ms. Vertin.
The metal box opens up. There is nothing inside.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: This is not a candy box. It is a pillbox.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Correction: It is an empty pillbox.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: You're back, Ms. Tooth Fairy. What did you find when you explored the campsite?

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Roughly the same as here. Near the woods, there's a place for firewood cutting.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: More traces left by critters can be found near the woods than here. I also found the teeth and claw marks of giant critter, as well as some excretion.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: That is to say, one gigantic critter inhabits here, if not more?

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Yes, that's why I came back here. Watch out for the critters. We may have stepped in their territory.
The bushes rustle.
Just like the crucibles always give off a whiff of smoke when a witch casts the spell ...
This is also the right moment for a spooky figure to rise from the bushes.

items.speaker: Critter
items.text: *roars*
Joint Committee of SF

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Yeah, I understand. I'll tell them to be careful. Yes, thank you for your advice. Bye.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Angie, come in.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: This is the file that the Timekeeper submitted. It's about the "Storm." Please hand it to the research department.

items.speaker: Female Investigator
items.text: Affirmative. I will bring it to them.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Next month, your squad will be dispatched to North America to join Zeno for a joint mission. The tactical unit under the Timekeeper will be replaced by the third squad. Please complete the handover procedure before you leave.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: By the way, your application for the outing permission has been permitted. The document will be posted to your dorm mailbox by 7 p.m. tomorrow.

items.speaker: Female Investigator
items.text: I'm very grateful for your help, Madam Z!

items.speaker: Z
items.text: You're welcome. Get some good rest.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Don't forget to remind your team members that actions outside areas mentioned in the application will not be allowed. They need to return back to the headquarters by the specified time and check in once they're back.

items.speaker: Female Investigator
items.text: I will, Madam Z. I will look after them.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Off you go. Oh hey, Angie …

items.speaker: Z
items.text: I heard that Tooth Fairy has returned to the Foundation. Please tell her to come by my office when she's available.

items.speaker: Female Investigator
items.text: Ms. Tooth Fairy? Emm. I suppose she has gone by now.

items.speaker: Female Investigator
items.text: On my way here, I saw Joshua and Vertin were with her. They seemed to be planning to travel.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Joshua? To travel?

items.speaker: Z
items.text: No, nope. I haven't received his outing application.

items.speaker: Female Investigator
items.text: Wh- ... which means …

items.speaker: Z
items.text: *sighs* ... He did have some past records of violation, such as being late, absent from duty, and taking actions without permission. His past records mean that his outing application will not be permitted.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: He must be well aware of it. That's why he wasn't even bother to apply for one.

items.speaker: Female Investigator
items.text: My! No wonder he always said, "Let's start off immediately and come back furtively, so nobody will know."

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Don't be nervous. Our priority now is to get them back and minimize the possible consequences. Angie, do you know where they are going?

items.speaker: Female Investigator
items.text: He ... he mentioned ... I'm trying to recall ...

items.speaker: Female Investigator
items.text: Emm. It's ... Green Lake. They were heading to Green Lake Campsite!

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Green Lake?

items.speaker: Z
items.text: You mean the Green Lake Campsite established by Zeno?

items.speaker: Female Investigator
items.text: Yes, Madam Z.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: It's even worse now.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: I'm sorry, Angie. Please inform the seventh and fifth squad to stand by. We'll head out at any time.

items.speaker: Female Investigator
items.text: Yes! I'll fetch them now!

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Hello, is it the Liaison Department of Zeno Armaments Academy? I am Z. Please put me through Lieutenant Vanya.
